cases.defect: The message body incorrectly starts with lowercase quieres after the salutation colon. Separately, the key is underdetermined: working on Friday does not establish that Jorge cannot attend the outing at eight.
cases.correction: Capitalize "¿Quieres". Specify that Jorge cannot attend at the proposed time, or explicitly ask the learner to select a refusal.

cases.reviewerAnswer: ¡Hola, Carmen! Lo siento, el sábado no voy porque trabajo. Nos vemos otro día. Un abrazo, Lucía.
cases.element: task.rubric.criteriaUk[2]: "Є хоча б одна причина з porque або протиставлення з pero."; task.rubric.exemplars[id=x1].text, task.hints[kind=reveal] and task.referenceAnswer: "¡Hola, Carmen! ¡Muchas gracias! Sí, quiero cenar en tu casa el sábado. Me gusta mucho tu cocina. Necesito comprar pan, ¿vale? Un abrazo, Ana".
cases.defect: The prompt explicitly requires an explanation with porque, but the rubric permits a contrast with pero instead. The supplied model contains neither and therefore fails both the prompt and that rubric criterion.
cases.correction: Require a porque clause consistently and add one to the exemplar, reveal hint and reference answer.
